verification.semanticRedEvidence: Author evidence records exit-1 ASSERTION_FAIL results before implementation and for root mismatch, malformed prior metadata, cache revision ahead of ledger, bracketed category/tags, valid inline tags, and malformed nested inline tags. Each RED names a behavioral assertion; setup and ABI failures were excluded.
verification.redChronologyLimit: The preimplementation RED transcripts and source snapshots were not retained. Chronology is author-reported; the repaired tests and final outcomes were independently inspected and run.

assessment: S11 final file validation gates document derivation. One ledger transaction commits classification, chunks, links and revision guard; a separate short keyword transaction replaces all old FTS rows for the document. Fault injection verifies ledger rollback, keyword rollback, durable keyword_dirty, retry and latest-only search results.

Source-ledger accepted category and tags survive later malformed frontmatter. Classification records diagnostics for bracketed category, nested list or object tag values; valid flat inline tag lists and comma-separated strings remain usable. Tests add these cases without weakening earlier assertions.

A source-root or tokenizer mismatch stays stale and does not expose incompatible keyword rows after a save. An authoritative ledger revision replaces a derivative cache revision ahead of it. The private owner drains saved work without adding a public index_document command or starting an unconditional rebuild.
documentedLimits: The owner derivation path is private and opt-in until a later producer transition connects product save paths.
An incompatible committed keyword cache keeps keyword_dirty set until an explicit Settings rebuild.
